left.title: Supreme Court nominee faces more grilling
left.body: It's day three for Judge Brett Kavanaugh as President Donald Trump's nominee to the Supreme Court faces another round of questions by lawmakers. Kavanaugh wrapped up his first round of probing after 12 hours of questions and answers before the Senate Judiciary Committee on Wednesday.
left.roundup: Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh will face a final barrage of questions on Thursday in a multi-day US Senate confirmation hearing, as Democrats press him on his independence from the man who nominated him, President Donald Trump.

right.title: Kavanaugh questioning enters final stretch, as Dems seem to lay traps
right.body: Supreme Court nominee Brett Kavanaugh enters what could be the final stretch of questioning in his confirmation hearing Thursday, with Democrats springing a series of cryptic questions – in an apparent attempt to box the nominee into an embarrassing admission or at least throw him off what has been a relatively steady performance.
